projects.title: Senior Thesis: "Information Technology and Communications and Development: Investigating Regional Differences in the Impact of ICT on Economic Growth"
projects.description: This paper studies the impact of information and communication technologies (ICT) on economic growth for a sample of 118 countries from 1980 to 2012. Further, I investigate whether this effect differs across regions, and compare this effect for two specific regions, Asia and sub-Saharan Africa. To estimate the effect of ICT on growth, I use mobile phone penetration rates as a measure of ICT, and address endogeneity by taking two-stage least squares regressions. The results do not confirm that ICT contributes significantly to growth, but they do demonstrate that the effect of ICT on growth differs across regions.
